mathematical_meanings: Left image: θ denotes the unknown angle at the lower-right vertex. Right image: θ denotes the angle between the radius and the positive horizontal axis.
Rationales: The left occurrence is located at θ beside the angle at the lower-right triangle vertex; the right occurrence is at θ beside the angle from the positive horizontal axis to the radius. Both use the selected notation for the same unknown-angle variable role. This compares the local role, without asserting that the two underlying objects or unknown values are identical.
